items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 51:1
items.html: The exit from Atzilut is called death, for they were separated from the light of Haya, since the light of Haya, which is the light of Hochma, does not illuminate outside Atzilut. Therefore the kings that fell into BYA died upon their separation from Atzilut, for the light of Haya flew away from them. And at the time of correction, when they returned and ascended to the world of Atzilut, they then rose to life. Therefore the return to Atzilut is called the resurrection of the dead. (p. 599, Item 1)
